command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "6b1abf3746168e27ee01272fa9a1267fd306d6bd" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
queries = [
 ('RH_CFG','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/rel_humidity_measurement_desc.h','typedef struct ezb_zcl_rel_humidity_measurement_cluster_server_config_s'),
 ('OCC_CFG','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/occupancy_sensing_desc.h','typedef struct ezb_zcl_occupancy_sensing_cluster_server_config_s'),
 ('ONOFF_CFG','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/on_off_desc.h','typedef struct ezb_zcl_on_off_cluster_server_config_s'),
 ('LEVEL_CFG','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/cluster/level_desc.h','typedef struct ezb_zcl_level_cluster_server_config_s'),
 ('CORE_HANDLER','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_core.h','ezb_zcl_core_action_handler_register'),
 ('SET_ATTR_MSG','managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl/zcl_common.h','typedef struct ezb_zcl_set_attr_value_message_s'),
]
for name,path,needle in queries:
    lines=Path(path).read_text().splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if needle in l]
    print(f'=== {name} ===')
    if not hits:
        print('NOT_FOUND'); continue
    i=hits[0]
    lo=max(0,i-4); hi=min(len(lines),i+30)
    print('\n'.join(lines[lo:hi]))
PY
